note: API list prices in US dollars per million tokens, used to compare what models cost per task. They are API-equivalent figures, not the subscription bill. input is ordinary input; cacheWrite a cache write (Claude: the 1-hour write, which `claude -p` sessions use; Codex: none charged, so ordinary input); cacheRead a cache read; output output. longContext applies to a call whose prompt is over `over` tokens. Claude: Anthropic's rate card effective 2026-11-09. Codex: OpenAI's API prices; gpt-6.2 from its 2026-11-17 release as reported by secondary sources, short-context rates (prompts up to 272k tokens).
